ScheduledEventItem.description: One concrete fire: a one-shot checkback or one slot of a cron schedule.

last_fire_error.description: Stored diagnostic of the last cancellation or failure; `reason` names it. Empty when there is none.

wake_payload.description: Input of the wake turn. A checkback carries `reason`, `check`, and `context_summary`; a cron fire carries `trigger` and the frozen schedule facts.

ScheduledEventItem.title: ScheduledEventItem

ProviderHostedWriteRequest.description: Sets any of the capability switches. Omitted keys stay unchanged.
ProviderHostedWriteRequest.title: ProviderHostedWriteRequest

computed_condition.description: CEL condition required when kind is computed

JSONValue.description: Any JSON-compatible value. AppConfigure validates the concrete key schema.
JSONValue.title: JSONValue

ScheduleRecurrence.description: Recurrence of one cron schedule. Kind `cron` uses `expression` and `timezone`; kind `every` uses `every_ms` and `anchor_at`.

anchor_at.description: ISO 8601 instant that the interval counts from.

expression.description: Crontab expression with five fields, or six fields with leading seconds.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. A write can omit it and give the request `timezone` instead. A stored `cron` recurrence carries it.

ScheduleRecurrence.title: ScheduleRecurrence

config.description: Per brain.* key: "ok", or {invalid: reason} for a broken stored row.

context_pack.description: Injection counters since this node booted.

skill_lessons.description: Skill-lesson drift signals, all read from agent_skill_lessons.

created_by.description: Origin of the schedule; `kind` names the writer.

execution_session_id.description: Derived session `cron:<id>` where every fire runs.

selectable.description: The kind is active and its Plugin is selected for the next start. This does not check cloud connectivity.

continued_from_job_id.description: The terminal Job that this Job continues; null for a first Job.

turns.description: One bounded page of runtime Turns, newest Turns first, in chronological order.

turns_next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the page of older Turns; null on the last page.

workspace_owner_job_id.description: The first Job of the continuation chain, whose Workspace every Job in the chain uses.

truncated.description: True when the folder has more folders or files than the listing shows

ProviderHostedCapabilities.description: Capabilities the Agent leaves to its language-model Provider. A capability set to true declares no Ankole tool or capability profile, and the Agent has no such capability when its Provider cannot run it.
ProviderHostedCapabilities.title: ProviderHostedCapabilities

owner_session_id.description: Conversation session that manages this schedule. Fires run in the derived execution session `cron:<schedule_id>`.

WorkerProviderCredentialsInput.description: Text replaces the stored credential. An empty string or an absent key keeps it. Null removes an optional credential.
WorkerProviderCredentialsInput.title: WorkerProviderCredentialsInput

ScheduleDelivery.description: Where the result of a fire goes. A target is a native conversation ID or an external reply route. An external primary target uses the schedule `binding_name`; a native primary target has no binding. When `quiet_success` is true, a fire with nothing to report sends no message. An update that omits `quiet_success` keeps the stored value.
ScheduleDelivery.title: ScheduleDelivery

SchedulePayload.description: Standing input of every fire. `task` is the self-contained instruction of a direct-Agent schedule; it is required unless an automation job consumes the trigger. Other keys pass through unchanged.
SchedulePayload.title: SchedulePayload

condition.description: CEL condition over the principal object

library_managed.description: True when a Brain Source owns the body projection. Use edit_block_reason to select the supported management action.

AgentSession.description: One Session surfaced from durable schedule, Signal, or job rows.
AgentSession.title: AgentSession

PermissionGrantCreateRequest.description: Exactly one owner: principal_uid or group_name.

resource_pattern.description: AuthZ resource glob pattern, for example workspace:**

PermissionGrantCreateRequest.title: PermissionGrantCreateRequest

ScheduleOccurrences.description: Bound of a recurring schedule: exactly one of `count` (due slots to run) or `until` (inclusive cutoff instant).

until.description: ISO 8601 instant, or a local time that the schedule timezone resolves. Stored as UTC.

ScheduleOccurrences.title: ScheduleOccurrences

member_since.description: Stored membership timestamp; null for evaluated computed members

orders.description: Full replacement standing-orders text; empty clears them.

consoleSession.description: The browser sends the sealed group and selected authentication cookies in the Cookie header. The group alone is not authentication. The shell supplies x-ankole-authentication for selection and x-csrf-token for unsafe requests.
consoleSession.name: Cookie
